product_summary: Online bicycle retailer (Shopify store unitedbycycling.com) with a physical store on Goshree Road, Mulavukad, Kochi. Catalogue as of fetch: ~247 bicycles (road 80, gravel 32, mountain 88, hybrid 39, electric 8), bike frames, and a full components/accessories range — drivetrain (chains, cassettes, derailleurs, cranksets, chainrings, shifters), brakes (disc/rim, pads, levers), wheels/rims/hubs/spokes/thru-axles, tyres & tubes, handlebars/stems/headsets, saddles/seatposts, pedals, tools, pumps, mudguards, racks, bike bags, lights, locks, helmets, apparel (jerseys, bibshorts, gloves, socks, shoes, glasses), nutrition (Unived gels), indoor trainers, power meters, heart-rate monitors, cyclo-computers. Brands carried: Merida, Marin, Pinarello, Argon 18, Cannondale, Cervelo, Colnago, Polygon, Kona, Look, Chapter2, Surly, Van Nicholas, Wilier Triestina, Vaan (e-bikes), Shimano, SRAM, Park Tool, Topeak, 2XU, Unived. Self-described as 'authorised dealer' and 'one-stop destination for bikes, cycle parts, components, accessories, nutrition, training aids, apparel, tools'.

comment: Declared 871200 (bicycles) and 871499 (bicycle parts n.e.s.) are directionally correct and cover the core of the catalogue — status partial, not wrong. 871200 is corroborated by the site's own product listings (road/gravel/MTB/hybrid/electric bikes, e.g. Cannondale Quick 3, Pinarello F5, Vaan Stelvio e-MTB). 871499 is a residual code and is too coarse: the bulk of the range belongs to specific subheadings 8714.91–8714.96 (frames/forks, wheels, hubs, brakes, saddles, pedals/cranksets), so the declaration should be split. Product lines entirely missing from the declaration: helmets (6506), cycling apparel and shoes (61/62/6404), nutrition/energy gels (2106.90), cycling glasses and computers (9004/9029), indoor trainers (9506.91). Industry claim 'Авиастроение и транспорт' (aircraft & transport) is a misclassification — this is sporting goods / bicycle retail, no aviation link found. Trader signs: multi-brand resale, 'authorised dealer' wording, no factory or own-brand manufacturing page; site is a Shopify storefront. All product data above is from the company's own website (unitedbycycling.com, About Us and Electric Bikes collection pages) — заявлено, не подтверждено: no customs line or shipment record was checked in this task, so no HS code here is corroborated by an actual declaration line. Note: the site does not state the legal entity name 'United By Cycling Private Limited' anywhere on the pages read; the link between the brand/store and the specific legal entity is not established from public web content (null).
